run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch GTN loss example to compute sequence criterion loss and gradients
create_gtn_loss_function: create a custom PyTorch autograd function using GTN graphs for sequence-level loss computation
build_target_graph: build a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to multiple frames
compute_forward_loss: compute the forward loss by intersecting target and emission graphs then subtracting scores
compute_backward_gradients: compute backward gradients for GTN loss using parallel_for across the batch dimension
